User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the CrowdCare Guardian system, including administrators, volunteers, and control room operators.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

username.description: Unique username for logging into the system.

email.description: Email address of the user, used for contact and account recovery.

role.description: The assigned role of the user, determining access levels (e.g., 'Admin', 'Volunteer', 'Operator').

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

phoneNumber.description: Contact phone number for the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

Child.title: Child
Child.description: Stores the registration details for a child, including parent and emergency contact information, for the CrowdCare Guardian system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Child entity. This ID is embedded in the QR code.

childName.description: The full name of the registered child.

age.description: The age of the child at registration.

physicalDescription.description: Physical description of the child (clothing, hair color, height) for AI matching.

parentName.description: The full name of the parent or guardian registering the child.

parentMobileNumber.description: The primary mobile number for the parent or guardian, used for notifications.

emergencyContactName.description: Name of an alternative emergency contact person.

emergencyContactNumber.description: Mobile number for the alternative emergency contact.

medicalRequirements.description: Any medical alerts, allergies, or special requirements for the child.

registeredById.description: Reference to the User (Admin) who registered this child. (Relationship: User 1:N Child)

registrationDate.description: Timestamp when the child was registered in the system.

qrCodeUrl.description: URL to the generated QR code image for this child, useful for reprinting.

photoUrl.description: URL to the identification photo stored on GuardianNet.

isActive.description: Indicates if the child's registration is currently active for an ongoing event.

RescueEvent.title: RescueEvent
RescueEvent.description: Records an instance where a child's QR code was scanned by a volunteer, initiating a rescue alert in the CrowdCare Guardian system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the RescueEvent entity.

childId.description: Reference to the Child entity that was found. (Relationship: Child 1:N RescueEvent)

volunteerId.description: Reference to the User (Volunteer) who initiated this rescue event. (Relationship: User 1:N RescueEvent)

scanTime.description: Timestamp when the child's QR code was scanned.

locationLatitude.description: Latitude coordinate of the rescue location.

locationLongitude.description: Longitude coordinate of the rescue location.

status.description: Current status of the rescue event (e.g., 'Scanned', 'Processing', 'Parent Notified', 'Child Reunited', 'Duplicate').

statusUpdateTime.description: Timestamp of the last update to the rescue event's status.

notes.description: Any additional notes or remarks from volunteers or operators regarding the event.

statusPhotoUrl.description: URL to the photo taken by the volunteer at the time of rescue.

isDuplicate.description: Flag indicating if this rescue event was identified as a potential duplicate by the AI system.

processedByUserId.description: Reference to the User (Operator) who last processed or updated this event. (Relationship: User 1:N RescueEvent)

resolvedTime.description: Timestamp when the rescue event was marked as fully resolved (e.g., child reunited with parent).

Broadcast.title: Broadcast
Broadcast.description: Mass alerts sent by operators to all volunteers.
